segments.say: Watch the lady in the back.

segments.text: A free AI on GitHub erases *anything* from a photo. On your own laptop.
segments.say: This free AI on GitHub erases anything from a photo, and it runs on your own laptop.

segments.text: …text on comics… and wait for *the dog.*
segments.say: Text on comics, gone. And wait for the dog.
It's called IOPaint. Install it with one command, start it, and brush over anything you want gone.
With a diffusion model, it can even replace things.

segments.text: *Save this.* Send it to the friend who always photobombs.
segments.say: Save this, and send it to the friend who always photobombs.
